sections.title: Output protocol

fields.label: Output protocol
fields.hint: A protocol change takes effect after a reboot of the autopilot.

fields.label: BLHeli passthrough
fields.hint: Lets a configurator reach the ESCs through the autopilot.

sections.hint: ArduPilot sets the protocol for all motor outputs at once, not per timer group.

sections.title: Throttle and thrust

fields.label: Spin when armed
fields.hint: Throttle, 0-1, that the motors turn at the moment the vehicle arms. Just enough that every motor is visibly turning. This is a safety cue as much as a setting.

fields.label: Minimum flight throttle
fields.hint: The lowest throttle used in flight. Must be above the arming spin, or a descent can stop a motor.

fields.label: Hover throttle
fields.hint: Learned in flight. A value near 0.2 or near 0.8 means the aircraft is badly over- or under-powered.

fields.label: Thrust curve expo
fields.hint: Linearises the ESC's thrust curve. 0.55 suits most hobby ESCs; smaller propellers want less.

sections.hint: The group that genuinely has to be set per airframe. Every value is a fraction of full throttle, 0 to 1.

geometry.label: Frame class
geometry.hint: Which layout the firmware mixes for. Changing it redefines what Motor 3 means and takes effect after a reboot.

geometry.label: Frame type
geometry.hint: The arrangement within the class: X or Plus on a quad.

frame.note: ArduPilot mixes a fixed layout for the frame class and type. How far apart the motors are is not a parameter there, and the tuning absorbs the size of the frame, so there is nothing to set for it.

banks.label: Output
banks.hint: ArduPilot numbers every output on the board in one run, so there is no separate MAIN and AUX here. SERVO9 is usually the first AUX pin on a Pixhawk.

sections.title: Throttle and thrust

fields.label: Spin when armed
fields.hint: Throttle, 0-1, that the motors turn at the moment the vehicle arms. Just enough that every motor is visibly turning. This is a safety cue as much as a setting.

fields.label: Minimum flight throttle
fields.hint: The lowest throttle used in flight. Must be above the arming spin, or a descent can stop a motor.

fields.label: Hover throttle
fields.hint: Learned in flight. A value near 0.2 or near 0.8 means the aircraft is badly over- or under-powered.

fields.label: Thrust curve expo
fields.hint: Linearises the ESC's thrust curve. 0.55 suits most hobby ESCs; smaller propellers want less.
